# I Am the Wind  

As a child I was firmly convinced:  
the branches that sway,  
the reeds gently rocking, the windmill that spins,  
they all join together to make the wind blow in.  

So naive to believe: the ego is that One -  
he, the consciousness that encompasses all;  
my body and five senses  
offer experiences, sensations to the active witness  
who interprets my perceptions and sensations,  
wants to steer my thoughts and emotions - my deeds and actions, too.  

But now I know:  
I Am the wind that sways the branches,  
that rocks the reeds, that spins the windmill -  
the ego like the branch, like the reed,  
moves only as the Monad decrees.
